description: This file defines a React functional component called 'MenuPaneSelector' which manages different account menu panes such as general menu, sign-in, registration, and password confirmation, based on the 'menuPane' state. It imports several external modules and components, manages internal state for email and password, and renders different sub-components conditionally.

methods.name: MenuPaneSelector
methods.description: React functional component that renders different account menu panes based on current state.
